description: run_turn in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/turns.py has high cyclomatic complexity (CC ~49, ~189 lines, 18 parameters), making turn execution and supervision logic hard to follow and maintain.
goal: Decompose run_turn in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/turns.py into small, cohesive helper functions backed by a typed configuration/request dataclass (such as TurnRequest / TurnConfig) so run_turn and every helper function in turns.py meet Ruff complexity limits (no new noqa suppressions, remove any C901/PLR0913 noqa on run_turn if present) while keeping run_turn's public signature and all existing keyword arguments 100% backward-compatible for all existing callers and tests (accepting either the typed config object or the existing keyword parameters). Keep turns.py strictly within its 892-line budget, never modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json, and create zero new Python files. Add/extend unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_turns.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_turn_supervisor.py verifying the typed config object, backward-compatible run_turn kwargs, and decomposed helper behavior, and verify full uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Breaking run_turn into focused helpers with a typed config dataclass removes a major complexity hotspot while keeping all existing turn callers and tests green.
acceptance_criteria: apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/turns.py decomposes run_turn into cohesive helpers with a typed config/request dataclass so run_turn and its helpers satisfy Ruff complexity limits with no new noqa suppressions while remaining 100% backward-compatible with existing callers.

Unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_turns.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_turn_supervisor.py verify the typed config dataclass, backward-compatible kwargs, and turn supervision behavior; uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass.

All changes remain within apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/turns.py (<= 892 lines), apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_turns.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_turn_supervisor.py (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched), and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
